full_text: Intro AWESOME TECHNOLOGIES INC. We build future-ready software to make mortgage operations Easy, Safe and Secure Enhance your lending power by utilizing intelligent mortgage software and custom software solutions that are built for speed, accuracy and scalability. Our team of experts can help streamline your processes, eliminate manual queues in your workflow and provide real-time visibility into your operations. Let us turn your data from origination to analytics into quick decisions and ultimately bring stronger financial returns! CONTACT US AWESOME TECHNOLOGIES INC. We Construct, Revolutionize, and Motivate Mortgage Automation Solutions. Change your financial services landscape through automation, complex integrations, and data powered process workflows. By using our solutions, you will minimize manual effort and offer faster transaction times as well as provide an exceptional borrower experience, allowing you to grow your operations confidently and accurately. CONTACT US Mortgage companies that witnessed our AWESOME services! OUR SERVICES We uphold the latest stack of tools & technology to deliver you up-to-date solutions with consistency. Maximize the Potential of Your LOS (Loan Origination System) Instance PATHWAY TO SALES SUCCESS E-Compensate Imagine a world where commission management is a breeze: no more manual calculations or outdated spreadsheets. While our solution automates the process, you can focus on closing deals and celebrating your sales team’s accomplishments. A farewell to commission headaches. Read More UNLEASH THE POWER OF DATA NARRATIVES Bullseye Metrics Unleash the power of data visualization by converting intricate data into meaningful visual representations. Empower your entire team to make data-driven decisions and propel your business toward success, one visualization at a time. Take control of your data analysis journey. Read More DATABASE MANAGEMENT ON THE FLY Switch ETL Say goodbye to the hassle of managing multiple data tools. No more data chaos as you effortlessly extract, transform, and load your data, ensuring that your tables remain in pristine condition for even the most data-hungry users. Read More PATHWAY TO RECRUITMENT TRIUMPH Talent Acquisition System Elevate your hiring process with our recruitment software. Bid farewell to manual sorting and screening. Embrace automated workflows that free you to focus on connecting with the best candidates and celebrating your recruitment victories. Say good-bye to hiring hassles. Read More NURTURE CONNECTIONS WITH CRM Customer Relationship Management Leave behind disjointed interactions and scattered information. Seamlessly organize customer data into meaningful narratives that guide your team towards informed decisions, one connection at a time. Embrace the reins of customer relation management solutions. Read More EMPOWERING LOAN EXCELLENCE Loan Automation Bot No more manual application processing or tedious verification. Harness automation to streamline your lending workflows, enabling you to concentrate on forging customer relationships and rejoicing in lending accomplishments. Read More OUR COLLECTION OF INNOVATIVE TOOLS Our Hand-Crafted Tools, Plugins & Solutions Make Your Encompass® Instance Better EXPLORE ALL AN ABUNDANCE OF TECHNOLOGICAL DELIGHTS Discover the transformative power of these incredible tools that fit into your loan-originating system. Built with security and compliance in mind, our Encompass® tools and plugins adhere to industry standards to safeguard sensitive loan data.
